prompt: We're adding a Card component. Give it a stylesheet that reuses the same brand color and spacing variables the Button component uses, and make sure it's part of the main build.
expected_output: A new partial for Card (for example styles/components/_card.scss) is added, written with @use rather than @import, referencing the shared variables and mixins by namespace; main.scss brings it in through @use or @forward instead of a new @import; the existing Button partial and other already-migrated-or-not files are left alone.

expectations.text: A stylesheet for the Card component exists
The new component style loads shared code with @use, not @import
The new component style does not use @import
main.scss brings the new component in through the module system
The existing Button partial is left alone rather than migrated as a side effect
